name: unicode-wide-combining-emoji
description: Wide CJK, combining marks, emoji including ZWJ sequences and variation selectors, and a wide character straddling the right margin. The `even:` line divides the remaining width exactly; the `odd:` line does not, so a wide character has to wrap and leave the final column blank.
notes: Rows 4 and 5 (a ZWJ family sequence and variation selectors) carry no row or cell expectation on purpose: how many cells a ZWJ cluster occupies is a real difference between emulators, and pinning one answer here would decide the M1 backend evaluation by fixture rather than on merit. They are still fed, and the snapshot round-trip still has to reproduce whatever the chosen emulator does with them.
